messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH,

Thank you for your letter and for setting out your position.

By the figures you gave us - AS-14404 +5.9% at 45% of your cost, LCI-C +2.7% at 5% of your cost - the weighted effect on the price is about +2.8%, not the 4.45% you ask for. Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 81.0% (sc:70740@2026Q3).

The data does not support your price as it stands; the options below follow from it.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 5.21 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option B: EUR 5.15 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.
Option C: EUR 5.16 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, fixed price, no index clause.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part - material, conversion, overhead?

We are happy to go through the figures together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

Our offer is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

We can accept the 24-month term with 30 days payment, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause as we cannot offer a fixed price for this duration. We propose a revised price of EUR 5.60 per unit for this package, and our colleagues will provide the requested cost breakdown. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit. 

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Dear customer,

We appreciate your revised offer and your willingness to close the remaining gap. However, we have already reached our limit at €5.50 per unit and cannot concede further on price for either duration.

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. As an distributor committed to supporting your business, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.50 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer stays valid for 7 days. We hope to continue working with you and look forward to your decision.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
